==About==

An {{i|Aspen}} is the product of a third growth stage, first tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking an Aspen and selecting "Slice" will give you 6x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 15x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. An Aspen counts as {{i|Any Large Pumpkin}}. An Aspen can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
